description: This PHP source file defines an EmployeeDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides a wrapper around the Employee entity, adding methods for formatting dates, managing employee attributes such as location, job title, employment status, and retrieving employee name information.

classes.name: EmployeeDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Employee entity that adds methods to retrieve and set employee attributes, with date formatting and reference resolution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeDecorator with an Employee entity.

methods.name: getJoinedDate
methods.description: Returns the employee's join date formatted as a string, or null if not available.

methods.name: getDrivingLicenseExpiredDate
methods.description: Returns the driving license expiration date formatted as a string, or null if not available.

methods.name: getBirthday
methods.description: Returns the employee's birthday formatted as a string, or null if not available.

methods.name: getSmoker
methods.description: Returns true if the employee's smoker status is 1, otherwise false.

methods.name: setSmoker
methods.description: Sets the employee's smoker status based on a boolean or null input.

methods.name: setNationality
methods.description: Sets the employee's nationality by reference ID.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns 'ACTIVE' if employee is not terminated, otherwise 'TERMINATED'.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the first Location object associated with the employee, or null if none.

methods.name: setLocationById
methods.description: Sets the employee's location based on the location ID, updating references accordingly.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the employee's job title by reference ID.

methods.name: setEmpStatusById
methods.description: Sets the employee's employment status by reference ID.

methods.name: setJobCategoryById
methods.description: Sets the employee's job category by reference ID.

methods.name: setSubunitById
methods.description: Sets the employee's subunit (department/division) by reference ID.

methods.name: getFirstAndLastNames
methods.description: Returns concatenation of the employee's first and last names.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the employee, including first, middle, and last names.
